description: This file contains various platform-specific setup, upgrade, and configuration functions used in a Linux-based embedded device firmware environment. It manages UBI volume initialization, device-specific upgrade procedures, and environment configurations.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI volumes if running on initramfs for Asus devices.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Initializes UBI and sets environment variables for Xiaomi devices during setup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the board model.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for specific boards before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration during upgrade for certain device types.
